data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for ByteDance Pangle Android and iOS ad SDKs
data.what_it_does: Integrates ByteDance Pangle ad networks into Flutter apps, supporting ad types such as splash, rewarded video, fullscreen video, banner, feed, interstitial, draw, stream, and ecmaoll ads.
use_when: You need to display ByteDance Pangle or GroMore mediated ads in your Android and iOS Flutter apps.
You require various ad formats like splash, rewarded videos, banners, or native feed ads.
avoid_when: You are targeting web or desktop platforms.
You prefer using a generic multi-network ad aggregator instead of Pangle specifically.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Pangle ad formats and pool preloading.
Platform view and non-platform view options available.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and native SDK setup for Android and iOS.
Strict dependency on specific native Pangle SDK versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration in Android manifest and iOS Info.plist/CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager settings, along with native initialization.
